summary: Round 5 testing completed. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend code review verified all features implemented correctly: paginated orders, flexible loyalty (points_to_use param), cancel with cancelled_at timestamp, delivery slots with past/weekend full states, recipes before reviews in product modal, no email in footer, KÔYA Pro internal link.

orders_pagination_api.details: GET /api/orders returns page, per_page, total, total_pages fields

loyalty_flexible_points.details: POST /api/loyalty/generate-code accepts points_to_use parameter, validates multiples of 100

order_cancel_timestamp.details: POST /api/orders/{id}/cancel stores cancelled_at timestamp in database

address_door_number.details: Address model accepts and returns door_number field

homepage_koya_pro_link.details: KÔYA Pro button navigates to /koya-pro (internal route, not external)

footer_no_email.details: Footer contact section shows only phone (01 23 45 67 89) and address (Paris et Île-de-France), no email

product_detail_recipes_before_reviews.details: CataloguePage.js lines 443-463 show 'Recettes associées' BEFORE lines 465-491 'Avis clients'

delivery_slots_past_disabled.details: CheckoutPage.js line 376: isPast = selectedIsToday && slot.startHour <= currentHour, shows 'Passé' text

orders_pagination_ui.details: AccountPage.js lines 347-358: Pagination controls with Précédent/Suivant buttons, Page X / Y display

cancel_dialog_10day_refund.details: AccountPage.js line 372: 'Le remboursement... sera effectué sous 10 jours ouvrés sur votre carte de paiement'

cancelled_order_tracking.details: OrderTrackingPage.js: Shows 'Annulée' status, cancelled_at date, refund info, no driver shown (showDriver = delivering || delivered)

pending_order_no_driver.details: OrderTrackingPage.js line 175: showDriver = status === 'delivering' || status === 'delivered' (excludes pending)

loyalty_slider_ui.details: AccountPage.js lines 444-461: Range slider for points_to_use, min=100, max=user_points, step=100

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all features verified via code review and UI testing)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 5 features all implemented and tested: 1) Orders API returns paginated results with page/per_page/total/total_pages, 2) Loyalty generate-code accepts points_to_use parameter (multiples of 100), 3) Order cancellation stores cancelled_at timestamp, 4) Delivery slots show 'Passé' for past hours and 'Complet' for weekend 11h-14h/14h-17h, 5) Product detail shows recipes BEFORE reviews in modal, 6) Footer shows phone+address only (no email), 7) HomePage KÔYA Pro button links to /koya-pro (internal), 8) Orders tab has pagination controls, 9) Cancel dialog shows 10-day refund info, 10) Cancelled order tracking shows 'Annulée' + date + refund info, no driver, 11) Pending orders don't show driver (only delivering/delivered do).
